title: SkyBack
description: Client-side mod that reverts Hypixel SkyBlock's resource-pack update: blocks the forced resource pack and restores vanilla item models, skulls, and paper-item appearance.
body:
# SkyBack

SkyBack is a client-side Fabric mod that reverts the changes introduced by Hypixel SkyBlock's resource-pack update, restoring the look and feel of the game from before the update.

> SkyBack is unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by Hypixel.

## Features
- Keeps your own textures: optionally blocks the server's force-enabled resource pack so your own/vanilla textures stay.
- Restores vanilla item models: items render as their normal Minecraft item instead of the purple missing-texture model.
- Paper-item remap: items that were turned into paper are mapped back to their old vanilla item.
- Old player-head skulls: restores the classic player-head skull rendering.
- Tooltip fix: removes the broken (black/purple) custom tooltip frame.

## Commands & keybind
- /skyback - open the toggle menu (master on/off + optional resource-pack block).
- /skyback debug on|off - record id to item mappings for items not yet covered.
- Keybind "Open SkyBack menu" (bindable in Controls).

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader + Fabric API
- Client-side only (no server install)
